semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides essential high-purity electronic gases and semiconductor precursor gases crucial for semiconductor fabrication.
summary: Dalian Creditchem Semiconductor Materials Co.,LTD specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of high-purity electronic gases and semiconductor precursor gases. As a national high-tech enterprise, it supports the semiconductor value chain by supplying critical materials for semiconductor fabrication processes.

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Dalian with industrial bases in Dalian and Anhui, focusing on semiconductor materials manufacturing.
